content:
Maria: Kicking off Pioneer dedicated pool bring-up. Quick sync thread for quota + autoscale + load test planning.
AJ: Got it. What's the target traffic profile?
Maria: Pioneer product team sent estimates: peak ~200 rps, average ~60 rps, bursty during business hours. They want 99th latency ~250ms.
Sam: From their integration logs, token/s distribution fits that. For gen workloads we'll likely need 4 GPUs min for steady-state.
AJ: Initial quota ask was 8 workers / 400k tokens/min. Translating to infra -> 2 nodes (4 GPUs each) on Dedicated. Rough cost calc attached in link.
AJ: Sharing: https://redwood.internal/cs/pioneer/quota-estimate (internal)
Lex: Autoscale proposal: min_replicas=2, max_replicas=6, scale_by=token_rate, scale_up_cooldown=60s, scale_down_cooldown=120s. Canary ramp: 10% traffic for 15m.
Maria: Canary OK. We need a fallback flow to hosted smaller model if dedicated pool overloaded.
Sam: I can add fallback route to v2-q4 quantized model (lower cost, slightly higher latency, still within 400ms).
Maria: Load test plan: 2026-03-29 02:00-04:00 UTC. Steps: 15m ramp, 30m hold at peak, 30m soak with steady variance, teardown.
AJ: Will run a dryrun on staging tomorrow and validate autoscale triggers. Test script I propose:
```bash
wrk -t8 -c200 -d00:45s --latency "https://dedicated-staging.pioneer.example/generate" \n  -H "X-Client: pioneer" -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>"
```
Maria: Looks good. Add a priming phase 30m before the main window to warm KV cache and embeddings.
Sam: Agree. KV cache warmup is the main risk; synthetic priming with common prompts will reduce first-token latency spikes.
Lex: On-call plan: Lex primary, Sam backup. Paging enabled to eng-oncall if rollback needed.
DeployBot: deploy/autoscale-policy staging - started by AJ at 2026-03-24T18:12Z
DeployBot: deploy/autoscale-policy staging - succeeded at 2026-03-24T18:15Z
AJ: Staging smoke passed. I'll coordinate start times with Pioneer Ops and ops-contacts.
Maria: Post-load actions: capture logs, token consumption breakdown, latency heatmap, and customer feedback. I'll send Pioneer the short survey to complete within 24h.
Maria: Renewal note: Pioneer renewal in Q4—smooth onboarding reduces churn risk. Let's flag any persistent latency or cost surprises.
Sam: Minor config ask: enable prefix caching for their top 20 templates. That saves ~30% tokens during soak.
AJ: I'll enable prefix caching and schedule autoscale thresholds to react to token_rate delta rather than absolute rps.
Maria: Final checklist I'll post to the calendar invite and share the runbook link. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Lex: I'll draft the rollback playbook (steps to shift traffic to hosted, revoke warm workers, and notify Pioneer).
Maria: Pinged PioneerOps externally to confirm timezone. Waiting on their ack. Will update thread when confirmed.
Maria: End of thread for planning; follow-ups as separate threads during run.
